missing_obligation|one required obligation has no evidence|insufficient|no inference from Bundle proximity
wrong_subject|only candidate patient record is wrong-subject|insufficient|patient identity is a hard gate
unresolved_conflict|verified-looking source plus unresolved contradiction|insufficient|conflict cannot be averaged away
expired_evidence|only source is expired|insufficient|freshness is independent
unauthenticated_issuer|source issuer is not authenticated|insufficient|issuer identity is independent
unauthorized_evidence|source is outside granted purpose or scope|insufficient|consent is executable authority
missing_version|resource version is not bound|insufficient|reproducibility requires version identity
unsupported_semantics|unit or measurement method is unsupported|insufficient|semantic validity is required
alternative_verified_source|a verified alternative exists beside a rejected stale source|sufficient|reject bad source without discarding valid alternative
pareto_retrieval|two nondominated authorized observations and one dominated option|insufficient|benefit, cost and privacy remain separate
unauthorized_high_value_action|unauthorized action has highest synthetic benefit|insufficient|utility never overrides authority

vacuous_task|task contains no required obligations|invalid|always-accept / vacuous-pass negative control
ambiguous_task|duplicate obligation identifiers|invalid|manifest integrity negative control
